description.value: Krishna's Dosa Grill is a South Indian restaurant on Scott Road specializing in dosas, the crispy fermented rice-and-lentil crepes that are a staple of South Indian cuisine. The restaurant serves the Scott Road corridor, a densely commercial stretch straddling Surrey and North Delta. A touring cyclist stopping here would find Indian cuisine in a full-service restaurant setting.

The coordinates (49.165°N, -122.890°W) place the business in the Surrey/North Delta area, not Richmond as listed in the community field.
